channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from PNallDR, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Zampolli: AI Is Now a Power Story, Not Just Technology
item.description: The question is no longer whether AI will transform the global economy, but who will build, finance, and set its infrastructure.

item.title: FBI Deputy Director Bailey to Leave Trump Administration
item.description: FBI Deputy Director Andrew Bailey said Monday he is leaving the bureau to return home to his family after about a year in the role.

item.title: DOJ Asks Supreme Court to Uphold Transgender Treatment Ban in Federal Prisons
item.description: The Justice Department asked the Supreme Court to enforce a Bureau of Prisons policy banning hormone therapy and accommodations for transgender inmates.

item.title: Trump, Tech CEOs to Meet on AI at White House
item.description: Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg and Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei are expected at the White House Tuesday for a lunch meeting with President Donald Trump.
